clara/advisory-brief-planner.title: Plan an advisory assignment with Clara
clara/advisory-brief-planner.goal: Learn to turn a request into a clear assignment: the decision, evidence, deliverable and next work.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.scenario: Ciclo Arco is considering a bicycle collection service. Before producing advice, we need to establish what the owner wants and what the available notes can support.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.scope: An initial assignment plan using the supplied fictional notes. The lesson ends at the handoff; the service recommendation belongs to the next workflow.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.inputs: Open assignment-en.md and notes-en.md. The first specifies the decision, reader and limits; the second contains customer statements and operational information.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.request: Clara, plan this advisory assignment. Show what we need to decide, the proposed output, evidence we have, gaps and how the work should proceed.
steps: Clara reads the request and selected notes, identifies any material clarification, and proposes the assignment in ordinary language.
Review the decision, scope, deliverable and missing evidence. Clara records the plan and checks it against the exact sources using the current planning workflow.
Read the summary and handoff. Identify the supported Clara workflow that would continue the assignment and what it must preserve.
deliverables: Assignment contract and readable summary: what the work is for, its boundaries and intended output.
Validation report and handoff: whether the plan can proceed and what the next workflow should receive.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.review: Check that the plan keeps the owner as reader, compares the requested options and does not invent prices, demand or authority to contact people. A valid plan is not an executed recommendation.
checkpoints: Before drafting, identify the decision and intended reader.
At delivery, explain what will be produced next and which evidence remains missing.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.practice: Use the practice files, including revised-assignment-en.md and update-en.md, to plan the owner’s narrower request: an action list for checking pilot feasibility. Keep the original plan.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.success: The new plan reflects the changed objective and deliverable. Name the output and one condition that must be checked before a pilot can run.
clara/advisory-brief-planner.repeat: Describe the decision, reader, desired output and available files. Review Clara’s scope and evidence plan before the selected workflow executes it.

clara/advisory-case-director.title: Develop an advisory case with Clara
clara/advisory-case-director.goal: Learn to maintain an evidence-based working answer and update the next actions when new information arrives.
clara/advisory-case-director.scenario: Ciclo Arco needs an initial view on a bicycle collection service. Customer comments suggest possible interest; operating notes describe a limited way to test it.
clara/advisory-case-director.scope: One local advisory case using supplied notes. The output is a working assessment, not a financial forecast or authorization to launch.
clara/advisory-case-director.inputs: Open assignment-en.md and notes-en.md. They establish the decision, customer comments and vehicle availability. The working chat creates the case during the lesson.
clara/advisory-case-director.request: Clara, develop this case. Give me your current recommendation, the evidence and limits behind it, and the next work that would help the owner decide.
steps: Clara establishes the assignment and creates a local case. It registers the supplied materials and states a provisional answer with its conditions.
The current workflow records the reasoning and evidence relationships, then saves the working assessment. The voice thread explains the recommendation and unresolved questions.
Open the current workpaper and evidence map. Follow a material conclusion to its source and discuss which next check could change the answer.
deliverables: Current workpaper: recommendation, reasoning, important unknowns and proposed next actions.
Evidence map and case history: the sources behind conclusions and the changes made as the case develops.
clara/advisory-case-director.review: Customer interest is not a booking or proof of wider demand. Check what the vehicle note actually permits. Clara proposes a course of action; the owner decides whether to implement it.
checkpoints: At the first answer, identify what is supported and what is conditional.
At delivery, locate the source behind a conclusion and the next useful check.
clara/advisory-case-director.practice: Add update-en.md to the same teaching case. Ask Clara how the unavailable vehicle changes the assessment and next actions. Open the revised workpaper and preserved earlier version.
clara/advisory-case-director.success: The case acknowledges the changed vehicle availability and does not treat a possible loan as agreed. Explain what changed in the recommendation or its conditions.
clara/advisory-case-director.repeat: Ask Clara to resume the case, supply new evidence and state the decision you need. Review its updated answer, reasons and proposed next work.

clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.title: Review an advisory memo with Clara
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.goal: Learn to check whether an advisory document answers its assignment and whether its recommendation follows from the available evidence.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.scenario: An external memo recommends launching Ciclo Arco’s daily collection service. We will review the whole short memo against the owner’s request and source notes.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.scope: A supplied Markdown memo and local evidence. Its original drafting history is unavailable, so the review matches claims to evidence now supplied.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.inputs: Open external-memo-en.md, assignment-en.md and notes-en.md. The memo is the document under review; the other files establish what was requested and what is known.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.request: Clara, review this memo against the assignment and supplied notes. Explain whether it is usable, what needs correction and which decisions remain with the owner.
steps: Clara establishes the review contract, preserves the memo and prepares an inventory of its contents and the selected evidence.
The current review workflow examines scope, claims, reasoning, recommendation, limitations and readiness. The voice thread connects findings to the exact memo passages and source notes.
Open the review package. Read the overall delivery status, material findings and proposed corrections. The original stays intact; a revised memo requires its own review.
deliverables: Readable review package: overall conclusion, source comparisons, corrections and remaining uncertainty.
Validation audit and inventories: what was reviewed and whether the review record is complete.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.review: Compare the daily-service recommendation with actual customer statements and vehicle availability. A complete review record does not itself approve the memo or prove its claims.
checkpoints: Before reviewing, distinguish the deliverable from its supporting evidence.
At delivery, explain the readiness conclusion and find the passage and source behind a material finding.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.practice: Add update-en.md and request a new review of the unchanged external memo with the expanded evidence. Preserve the first review and compare their findings.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.success: The new review reflects the vehicle’s unavailability and makes its delivery consequence clear. State what must change before the memo can support the owner’s decision.
clara/advisory-deliverable-validator.repeat: Provide the document, its assignment and supporting sources. Read the overall review and material findings, then review any separate correction before using it.
